programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Le Grêlé : un tueur au-dessus de tout soupçon (1/2)
programme.desc:
Le 13 mai 2019, un homme a priori au-dessus de tout soupçon participe à l’un des jeux télévisés les plus regardés de France. Sur le plateau de « Tout le monde veut prendre sa place », Nagui accueille François Vérove, ancien policier et membre de la garde républicaine. Devant leur écran, les téléspectateurs sont loin d’imaginer que le souriant retraité, qui s’affiche en totale décontraction à la télévision, est en fait l’un des tueurs en série les plus recherchés de France ! 
C’est l’une des plus grandes énigmes criminelles françaises de ces 40 dernières années. Une traque qui commence à Paris en 1986, par la découverte du corps sans vie d’une fillette de 11 ans, Cécile Bloch. Le sort de cette enfant, abusée sexuellement avant d’être assassinée, émeut autant qu’il terrifie… Et ce n’est que le début : en 10 ans, le tueur commet quatre meurtres et au moins six viols. Surnommé « le Grêlé » en raison d’importantes marques d’acné sur le visage, il ne sera identifié que 35 ans plus tard, en 2021. 
Lorsque son identité est enfin connue, « le Grêlé » mène une vie paisible à La Grande-Motte (Hérault). Mari aimant, père et grand-père modèle, ancien gendarme serviable et dévoué : François Vérove n’a pas vraiment le profil attendu. Pourtant, juste avant d’être interpellé, l’homme laisse une brève lettre d’aveux et se donne la mort. 
Qui était vraiment François Vérove ? Comment, tel un « Docteur Jekyll et Mister Hyde », a-t-il réussi à tromper tout son monde aussi longtemps ? Pourrait-il être l’auteur d’autres crimes jusqu’ici non résolus ? À travers leurs témoignages, enquêteurs, victimes, voisins et collègues ont accepté, pour Enquêtes criminelles, de nous dévoiler les dessous de cette incroyable affaire.

Dans la seconde partie de l’émission, Enquêtes criminelles reviendra sur une autre affaire de gendarme meurtrier. Le 26 juin 2012, Claude Tavernier est découverte gisant au milieu de son salon, tuée de 42 coups de couteau. La maison a été fouillée et tout a disparu ! Claude Tavernier a-t-elle surpris un voleur avant qu’il ne s’acharne sur elle ? Après des mois d'enquête, une autre piste émerge. Un gendarme discret, bien sous tous rapports, qui serait en fait un meurtrier sanguinaire.

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Affaire Camille Anguenot : séductrice, menteuse, forcément suspecte ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
Ce 1er décembre 2021, Philippe a le cœur qui bat la chamade. Ce célibataire bordelais de 27 ans retrouve Camille, une hôtesse de caisse de 18 ans, passionnée d’équitation, qu’il a rencontrée sur les réseaux sociaux une semaine plus tôt. Seulement, Philippe est loin de se douter que la jeune femme avec laquelle il a rendez-vous est en fait recherchée par la police. En effet, les enquêteurs la soupçonnent d’avoir tué un certain Théo Decouchant, 23 ans, à 700 kilomètres de là, dans le petit village où vit Camille !
Depuis trois jours, les amis de Théo Decouchant, 23 ans, s’inquiètent. Le jeune peintre en bâtiment n’est pas venu au travail. Il ne répond plus ni à leurs appels ni à leurs messages… En fait, ils n’ont plus de nouvelles depuis que le jeune homme a passé, il y a quelques semaines, la soirée avec Camille Anguenot, une jeune femme très entreprenante avec laquelle il avait flirté en boite de nuit. Le rendez-vous galant aurait-il mal tourné ? Pour le savoir, les amis de Théo, décident de contacter Camille, en enregistrant la conversation. À l’autre bout du fil, elle est formelle : ils ont bien passé la nuit ensemble mais elle aurait préféré en rester là. Alors, Théo, le cœur brisé, aurait-il mis fin à ses jours ? Ses amis n’y croient pas une seconde, d’autant qu’ils ne vont pas tarder à faire une étrange découverte : quelques heures après la disparition de Théo, un témoin aurait croisé Camille partant rejoindre un autre « amoureux » à Bordeaux au volant d’une voiture… Et pas n’importe laquelle : la voiture du disparu ! De toute évidence, la jeune femme qu’ils ont eu au téléphone se serait moquée d’eux. 

Dans la deuxième partie de l’émission, Enquêtes Criminelles s’intéressera à une autre affaire dans laquelle un corps est caché dans la maison. Le 11 août 2014, Laurent Baca, père de 4 enfants, est porté disparu. Sa famille met alors toute son énergie à tenter de trouver une trace de ce trentenaire, éducateur auprès de jeunes footballeurs. Et s’il avait été tué ? Les enquêteurs commencent à s’interroger. Et c’est une odeur insoutenable dans la maison qui va révéler l’effroyable vérité !

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Affaire Camille Anguenot : séductrice, menteuse, forcément suspecte ? (2/2)
programme.desc:
Ce 1er décembre 2021, Philippe a le cœur qui bat la chamade. Ce célibataire bordelais de 27 ans retrouve Camille, une hôtesse de caisse de 18 ans, passionnée d’équitation, qu’il a rencontrée sur les réseaux sociaux une semaine plus tôt. Seulement, Philippe est loin de se douter que la jeune femme avec laquelle il a rendez-vous est en fait recherchée par la police. En effet, les enquêteurs la soupçonnent d’avoir tué un certain Théo Decouchant, 23 ans, à 700 kilomètres de là, dans le petit village où vit Camille !
Depuis trois jours, les amis de Théo Decouchant, 23 ans, s’inquiètent. Le jeune peintre en bâtiment n’est pas venu au travail. Il ne répond plus ni à leurs appels ni à leurs messages… En fait, ils n’ont plus de nouvelles depuis que le jeune homme a passé, il y a quelques semaines, la soirée avec Camille Anguenot, une jeune femme très entreprenante avec laquelle il avait flirté en boite de nuit. Le rendez-vous galant aurait-il mal tourné ? Pour le savoir, les amis de Théo, décident de contacter Camille, en enregistrant la conversation. À l’autre bout du fil, elle est formelle : ils ont bien passé la nuit ensemble mais elle aurait préféré en rester là. Alors, Théo, le cœur brisé, aurait-il mis fin à ses jours ? Ses amis n’y croient pas une seconde, d’autant qu’ils ne vont pas tarder à faire une étrange découverte : quelques heures après la disparition de Théo, un témoin aurait croisé Camille partant rejoindre un autre « amoureux » à Bordeaux au volant d’une voiture… Et pas n’importe laquelle : la voiture du disparu ! De toute évidence, la jeune femme qu’ils ont eu au téléphone se serait moquée d’eux. 

Dans la deuxième partie de l’émission, Enquêtes Criminelles s’intéressera à une autre affaire dans laquelle un corps est caché dans la maison. Le 11 août 2014, Laurent Baca, père de 4 enfants, est porté disparu. Sa famille met alors toute son énergie à tenter de trouver une trace de ce trentenaire, éducateur auprès de jeunes footballeurs. Et s’il avait été tué ? Les enquêteurs commencent à s’interroger. Et c’est une odeur insoutenable dans la maison qui va révéler l’effroyable vérité !

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Yves Chatain : un tueur en série en liberté ? (1/2)
programme.desc: C’est l’histoire d’un crime résolu de façon inattendue, presque inespérée, après trente-six ans de mystère. Le 8 mai 2022, Yves Chatain, un chauffeur routier de 56 ans, avoue le meurtre de Marie-Thérèse Bonfanti, une jeune mère de famille disparue à Pontcharra (Isère) le 22 mai 1986. Pour les proches de la mère de famille, cette révélation a un goût amer. Car le suspect pourrait bien ne jamais aller en prison ! En effet, pour la justice, le crime serait prescrit. C’est d’autant plus cruel et frustrant que le suspect était dans le dossier depuis le début : la maison devant laquelle Marie-Thérèse s’est volatilisée appartenait en effet à Yves Chatain, et plusieurs témoignages, dont celui du mari de la disparue, attestent de la présence du propriétaire sur les lieux ce jour-là ! Comment est-il possible que l’homme n’ait pas vraiment été inquiété alors qu’à l’époque il avait déjà été condamné pour des faits de violence ? Et ce n’est pas tout : l’affaire Bonfanti ne serait pas un cas isolé. Yves Chatain est aujourd’hui suspecté dans plusieurs autres affaires criminelles… \r\n\r\nÀ la suite, « Enquêtes criminelles » reviendra sur l’affaire Sophie Le Tan, une jeune femme de 20 ans disparue en septembre 2018 près de Strasbourg (Bas-Rhin) et dont des ossements ont été retrouvés un an plus tard dans une forêt à une quarantaine de kilomètres de là. À quelques jours de la rentrée universitaire, l’étudiante avait répondu à une offre très intéressante sur un site de petites annonces gratuites : un studio pas trop cher à Schiltigheim. Seulement, elle n’est jamais revenue du rendez-vous. Serait-elle tombée dans un piège ? En étudiant les communications passées dans le secteur, les policiers sont parvenus à remonter jusqu’à un homme de 58 ans au profil particulièrement inquiétant : Jean-Marc Reiser. Déjà condamné pour viol, il habite justement dans l’immeuble où Sophie Le Tan devait se rendre….

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Laure Zacchello : la nouvelle affaire Jubillar ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
Laure Zacchello, une mère de famille de 43 ans originaire d’Urrugne (Pyrénées-Atlantiques), n’a plus donné signe de vie depuis le 21 juin 2024. Cette inquiétante disparition cacherait-elle un féminicide ? C’est l’intime conviction des enquêteurs. À première vue pourtant, tout semble écarter la piste du mari. Le jour de la disparition de sa femme, l’homme avait été retrouvé dans le jardin du domicile familial, inconscient et ensanglanté, un parpaing à côté de la tête. Seulement, pour les enquêteurs, il s’agirait d’une mise en scène pour camoufler son crime. 
En effet, avant de disparaître, Laure aurait confié à ses proches craindre pour sa vie. Ne supportant plus les éclats de colère et les crises de jalousie de son mari, elle avait demandé le divorce. Mais Alexis, lui, n’aurait pas accepté la rupture et, en représailles, aurait fait vivre à sa femme un enfer. Laure était tellement apeurée qu’elle mettait une chaise derrière la porte ou entourait d’objets le canapé sur lequel elle dormait pour s’assurer d’entendre son mari arriver. Et ce n’est pas tout : l’homme a un profil pour le moins inquiétant. Survivaliste, il posséderait plusieurs caches dans la montagne et disposait chez lui d’un véritable arsenal de guerre : deux armoires remplies d’armes à feu. Et dans le lot, plusieurs pistolets mitrailleurs et automatiques ont disparu. Alors, qu’est-il vraiment arrivé à Laure Zacchello ? Son mari, qui nie toute implication et jure être atteint d’amnésie, dit-il vraiment toute la vérité ? 

Dans la deuxième partie de l’émission « Enquêtes criminelles » s’intéressera à l’affaire Philippe Marchand. Le 16 octobre 2017, de retour après un mois d'hospitalisation, le retraité signale la disparition d’Anne-Marie Richy, sa compagne. Rapidement des messages et des mails le prouvent, Anne-Marie serait bien vivante. Terrible méprise… Pendant deux ans, ce n’est pas la disparue qui envoie ces messages rassurants mais le fringant sexagénaire alors au-dessus de tout soupçon...

programme.title: Celtas: La historia secreta

programme.title: Cuentos de miedo de Nueva York
programme.desc: El principal sospechoso de un horrible triple homicidio, el escultor de cera Robert Irwin, vendió su historia para financiar su defensa y librarse de la pena de muerte.

programme.title: Ninja a cuadros: el orig3n
programme.desc: Un adolescente que ha perdido el interés por las aventuras ninja debe recuperar la confianza en sí mismo cuando un matón amenaza su rutina. Con la ayuda de su mágico y descuidado amigo, se enfrenta a sus miedos en una misión cargada de ingenio y acción.

programme.title: Chicken Jazz
programme.desc: Teo es un extrompetista que trabaja en la pollería que su padre le dejó en herencia. Su vida transcurre monótona hasta que su ex aparece con su antigua trompeta.

programme.title: GOAT: La cabra que cambió el juego
programme.desc: Will, una pequeña cabra con grandes sueños, recibe la oportunidad de unirse al equipo profesional de rugebol, un deporte de alta intensidad dominado por los animales más rápidos y feroces. Ahora, está decidido a demostrar que ¡los pequeños saben jugar!

programme.title: Lo que queda de ti
programme.desc: Tras morir su padre y heredar la granja de este y un rebaño de ovejas, Sara deja atrás una prometedora carrera en Nueva York como pianista y, junto a su hermana Elena, decide regresar a sus raíces.

programme.title: Así se hizo 'Cronos': los testimonios reales
programme.desc: Contenido exclusivo de la película 'Cronos', ya en cines. Los testimonios de los protagonistas reales del dispositivo activado tras al atentado terrorista de Las Ramblas.

programme.title: Rondallas
programme.desc: Dos años después del naufragio de un pesquero gallego, los conmocionados habitantes del pueblo de aquellos pescadores van a encontrar consuelo y esperanza en su rondalla, la tradicional banda de música rural gallega.

programme.title: Viaje al país de los blancos
programme.desc: Este luminoso drama cuenta la odisea, basada en una historia real, de un joven africano y su viaje a España, donde le esperan frustraciones y dificultades, pero también segundas oportunidades y el amor incondicional de una madre de acogida.

programme.title: Gail Daughtry y el vale por un rollo VIP
programme.desc: Gail, una peluquera de pueblo, descubre la traición de su prometido Tom. Junto a su amigo Otto, viaja a Hollywood, enfrentándose a desafíos hilarantes y peligrosos que pondrán a prueba su amistad y cambiarán sus vidas.

programme.title: Guillermo Tell
programme.desc: En 1307, las fuerzas austriacas oprimen al pueblo suizo. En este contexto, Guillermo Tell, que juró tras las Cruzadas no volver a utilizar su ballesta para matar a un hombre, se ve obligado a unirse a la rebelión para detener el derramamiento de sangre.

programme.title: Yo siempre a veces (Extras)

programme.title: Magazin D Pazar
programme.desc: Hafta sonu magazin gündeminin nabzını tutan program, ünlülerin hayatlarına dair özel detaylar, etkinliklerden renkli görüntüler ve sürpriz röportajları izleyiciyle buluşturuyor. Kamera arkası ve kulis görüntüleriyle desteklenen içerik, eğlenceli ve akıcı sunumuyla hafta sonuna keyifli bir başlangıç sağlıyor. Magazin D Pazar, güncel olayları ve ünlülerin dünyasını izleyicilere hem bilgilendirici hem de eğlenceli bir şekilde aktarmayı hedefliyor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pazar Gezmesi
programme.desc: Pazar Gezmesi, Kanal D ekranlarında ünlü isimlerin evlerine konuk olunan özel bir magazin programıdır. Programda sanat, televizyon ve müzik dünyasından tanınmış isimlerin ev yaşamları, özel anıları ve samimi sohbetleri izleyiciyle paylaşılır. Doğal ve sıcak anlatımıyla dikkat çeken yapım, ünlülerin bilinmeyen yönlerini ortaya çıkarırken, pazar günlerine keyifli ve rahat bir izleme deneyimi sunar. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Arda İle Omuz Omuza
programme.desc: Arda ile Omuz Omuza, mutfağı bir buluşma noktasına dönüştüren keyifli bir sohbet ve yemek programıdır. Her bölümde ünlü bir konuk, Arda'nın mutfağında ağırlanır; birlikte yemek yapılırken hayata dair samimi sohbetler edilir, anılar paylaşılır ve sofranın insanları nasıl bir araya getirdiği keşfedilir. Pratik tarifler, mutfak tüyoları ve bol kahkaha eşliğinde ilerleyen program, izleyiciye hem ilham verir hem de ev sıcaklığında bir deneyim sunar. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Yerli Dizi
programme.desc: Yerli Dizi sürükleyici hikayesi ve güçlü karakterleriyle izleyiciyi ekran başına kilitliyor. Sırlar, aşk ve entrikalar karakterlerin hayatlarını derinden etkilerken her bölümde gerilim ve duygusal yoğunluk artıyor. Karakterler zor seçimlerle karşılaşırken izleyici olayların gelişimini heyecanla takip ediyor. Hikaye sürpriz gelişmeler, beklenmedik karşılaşmalar ve dramatik anlarla dolu olarak ilerliyor ve her bölüm izleyicide merak duygusunu artırıyor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sıcak Gelişme
programme.desc: Gün boyunca yaşanan önemli olayları ve son dakika gelişmelerini hızlı ve güvenilir şekilde izleyiciye aktaran bir haber bültenidir. Siyaset, ekonomi, dünya gündemi ve toplumsal olaylar gibi farklı alanlardaki gelişmeler sade ve anlaşılır bir dille sunulur. Dinamik yapısı sayesinde izleyiciyi güncel tutmayı hedefler. Kısa sürede en önemli başlıkları öne çıkararak bilgilendirici ve akıcı bir haber deneyimi sağlar. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kanal D Haber Hafta Sonu
programme.desc: Hafta sonu gündemini kapsayan Kanal D Haber Hafta Sonu, Türkiye ve dünyadan en güncel haberleri izleyiciyle buluşturuyor. Deneyimli muhabirler ve canlı bağlantılar aracılığıyla son dakika gelişmeleri aktarılırken, ekonomi, siyaset ve sosyal olaylara dair analizler de sunuluyor. İzleyiciler, hafta sonu boyunca yaşanan önemli gelişmeleri hızlı, güvenilir ve kapsamlı bir şekilde takip edebiliyor. Program, doğru ve tarafsız haber anlayışıyla izleyiciye kapsamlı bir haber deneyimi sunmayı hedefliyor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Daha 17
programme.desc: 17 yaşındaki bir grup gencin lise döneminde yaşadığı dostluklar, ilk aşklar, aile baskısı ve hayaller arasında şekillenen hayatları konu edilir. Her biri kendi kimliğini bulmaya çalışırken, büyümenin getirdiği zorluklarla da yüzleşir. Yanlış kararlar, kırgınlıklar ve umut dolu anlar iç içe geçerken, gençlerin kendilerini keşfetme yolculuğu ön plana çıkar. Dizi, ergenliğin karmaşasını ve arkadaşlığın gücünü gerçekçi ve duygusal bir dille anlatır. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Tülin Şahin İle Moda moda dünyasındaki trendleri, stil önerilerini ve ilham verici içerikleri izleyiciye sunuyor. Moda meraklıları için güncel gelişmeler, dikkat çekici kombinler ve ilham verici fikirler ekrana taşınıyor. Her bölümde şıklık, yaratıcılık ve stil dolu öneriler izleyiciyi ekrana bağlıyor. programme.title: Bizden Bize
programme.desc: Toplumsal yaşamı ilgilendiren sosyal, kültürel ve güncel konuların ele alındığı program, farklı görüşleri ve uzman değerlendirmelerini bir araya getiriyor. Gündelik hayata dair meseleler, deneyimler ve yorumlarla zenginleştirilerek izleyiciye aktarılıyor. Samimi bir sunum diliyle hazırlanan içerik, hem bilgilendirici hem de düşündürücü bir yayın akışı sunuyor. programme.title: Vahe İle Evdeki Mutluluk
programme.desc: Her bölümde farklı bir ailenin evine konuk olan program, yaşam alanlarını yenileyerek hem fiziksel hem de duygusal bir dönüşüm sunuyor. Vahe Kılıçarslan'ın enerjisi ve samimi yaklaşımıyla evler modern, kullanışlı ve estetik bir görünüme kavuşurken, ailelerin hayatına da moral ve mutluluk katılıyor. Gerçek hikâyeler, sıcak anlar ve pratik dekorasyon dokunuşlarıyla program, izleyicilere hem ilham hem de iyi hissettiren bir deneyim yaşatıyor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Meraklı Mikrofon

programme.title: Rotamız Başarı

Kişisel gelişim ve ilham odaklı yapısıyla program, izleyicilere kendi hedeflerine ulaşma yolunda farklı bakış açıları kazandırmayı amaçlıyor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Star Haber

programme.title: Verkauft
programme.desc: Eine junge Frau wird mit dem Versprechen auf ein besseres Leben in eine brutale Welt voller sexueller Ausbeutung gelockt.

programme.title: Die Schwiegermutter
programme.desc: Als ein Paar in den Dreissigern eine ihrer Mütter in ihr Haus lässt, ahnt es nicht, dass es gerade eine Art Fegefeuer betreten hat. Ihr friedliches Leben wird ins Chaos gestürzt, als die Grenzen der Privatsphäre zerstört werden.

programme.title: Hochzeit auf Kuba
programme.desc: Als Loes einen Anruf von der kubanischen Botschaft erhält, ist sie sprachlos. Sie wusste nichts von der Beziehung ihrer Tochter, geschweige denn, dass sie einen Kubaner heiraten will. Sie bucht einen Flug nach Havanna, um die Hochzeit zu vereiteln.

programme.title: Kojote
programme.desc: Misi ist ein frustrierter junger Mann, der es in seinem Leben schwer hat. Als er das ungarische Anwesen seines Grossvaters erbt, beschliesst er, es zu renovieren. Er beginnt die Arbeiten mit anderen Einwohnern, doch dies gefällt dem Oligarchen nicht.

programme.title: Das Waisenhaus
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1911 gibt Louise Perreau ihren Sohn in die Obhut des Waisenhauses und Internats "Les Vermiraux". Doch sie weiss nicht, dass die dort lebenden Kinder hinter verschlossenen Türen gewaltsam gequält werden. Schliesslich schlagen sie zurück.

programme.title: Der verfluchte Fluss
programme.desc: Andrejs rettet seine Schwester und eine Gruppe von Influencern, die sich an einem Fluss in einem abgelegenen Tal verirrt haben. Sie wollten eigentlich einen Werbespot drehen. Doch was sie vorfinden, übersteigt das menschliche Vorstellungsvermögen.

programme.title: Nur du
programme.desc: Elisabeth steht kurz davor, ihre Jugendliebe zu heiraten. Arthur ist im Begriff, für eine lange Reise alles hinter sich zu lassen. Als die beiden aufeinandertreffen und sich Hals über Kopf ineinander verlieben, ändert sich alles.

programme.title: Das Geheimnis der Medusa
programme.desc: Nachdem ein junger Taucher in den Tiefen des Ozeans eine goldene Medusa-Statuette findet, verschwindet er auf mysteriöse Weise. Die Ermittler entdecken, dass ein Fluch auf dem Artefakt liegt und geraten bald selbst in grosse Gefahr.

programme.title: Ma meilleure amie
programme.desc: Francesco, avocat maladroit, et Claudia, vétérinaire, sont meilleurs amis. Or, lorsqu'elle rencontre Giovanni et décide de l'épouser, leur relation se complique. Francesco commence à s'interroger sur ses vrais sentiments à son égard.

programme.title: La maison du lac
programme.desc: Un couple dont la femme est enceinte s'installe dans une maison isolée au bord d'un lac. Or, ils sont confrontés à l'apparition d'une présence maléfique et de sa victime précédente, une petite fille fantôme qui répond au nom d'Estela.

programme.title: Sans Filtre
programme.desc: Tout juste sorties du lycée, Lavinia, Carla et Danila partent en vacances en yacht. Accompagnées uniquement d'un skipper, elles naviguent le long de la côte croate, marquant ainsi le début d'une nouvelle étape dans leur vie.

programme.title: Emprise
programme.desc: Mo et Vera sont surpris en train de tricher pendant un examen par Ursu, le professeur le plus sévère de l'université. Après lui avoir demandé une seconde chance, le professeur les invite chez lui pour qu'ils passent un étrange examen.

programme.title: L'Heure Sombre
programme.desc: Rares survivants d'une guerre bactériologique, une petite communauté dirigée vit enfermée dans un immeuble en plein délabrement. Dehors, l'ensemble de la population a été transformée en zombies : le moindre contact et c'est la mort assurée.

programme.title: Ma meilleure amie
programme.desc: Francesco, avocat maladroit, et Claudia, vétérinaire, sont meilleurs amis. Or, lorsqu'elle rencontre Giovanni et décide de l'épouser, leur relation se complique. Francesco commence à s'interroger sur ses vrais sentiments à son égard.

programme.title: Le crime parfait
programme.desc: La principale suspecte dans une affaire d'homicide pourrait être également la meurtrière de la propre fille de l'enquêteur des années plus tôt. Nourri d'une soif de vengeance, il met tout en œuvre pour établir sa culpabilité.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: Dans une Allemagne dystopique aux mains d'un pouvoir autoritaire, une maison connectée se retourne contre son propriétaire... Un troublant thriller d'anticipation en forme de huis clos psychologique.

programme.title: Emprise
programme.desc: Mo et Vera sont surpris en train de tricher pendant un examen par Ursu, le professeur le plus sévère de l'université. Après lui avoir demandé une seconde chance, le professeur les invite chez lui pour qu'ils passent un étrange examen.

programme.title: Venduta
programme.desc: Una giovane donna, attirata dalla falsa promessa di un lavoro, decide di lasciare il proprio paese.

programme.title: La suocera
programme.desc: Una giovane coppia accoglie la suocera in casa per qualche giorno. La suocera si trattiene troppo a lungo e la coppia lotta per recuperare la propria casa.

programme.title: Matrimonio a Cuba
programme.desc: Convinta che sua figlia stia commettendo un errore, una madre diffidente si reca a Cuba per impedirle di sposarsi. I suoi piani prendono presto una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Coyote
programme.desc: Dopo aver ereditato dal nonno una casa in una remota cittadina, un giovane uomo decide di ricominciare e costruirsi una nuova vita. Qui, si trova coinvolto in un brutale conflitto contro il magnate locale.

programme.title: L'orfanotrofio
programme.desc: All'inizio del 1900, viene alla luce l'orribile verità che si nasconde tra le pareti di un orfanotrofio, quando i bambini iniziano a ribellarsi.

programme.title: Il fiume del terrore
programme.desc: A una guida locale viene chiesto di accompagnare un gruppo di influencer lungo il fiume di una valle remota. Man mano che si addentrano nella natura selvaggia, la loro impresa prende una piega spaventosa.

programme.title: Anima gemella
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio, una ragazza incontra l'amore della sua vita. Decidono di passare tutta la notte insieme.

programme.title: L'enigma di Medusa
programme.desc: Dopo aver trovato una statuetta d'oro di Medusa nelle profondità dell'oceano, un giovane sommozzatore scompare misteriosamente. Gli investigatori della polizia scoprono una maledizione che circonda il manufatto e si trovano in grave pericolo.

programme.title: Ma meilleure amie
programme.desc: Un homme prend conscience de ses véritables sentiments lorsque sa meilleure amie lui annonce qu'elle va se marier. Va-t-il lui avouer son amour ?

programme.title: La maison du lac
programme.desc: Un couple s'installe dans une maison isolée au bord d'un lac pour fonder une famille. Ils découvrent bientôt que la demeure est hantée par le fantôme d'une fillette.

programme.title: Sans filtre
programme.desc: Trois amies se rendent en mer sur un bateau pour fêter la fin des années lycée, mais leur rapport aux réseaux sociaux devient vite problématique.

programme.title: Emprise
programme.desc: Mo et son amie Vera sont surprises en train de tricher à leur examen par Ursu, leur professeur d'université. Lorsque Mo demande une seconde chance, le professeur les invite chez lui. Tout au long de la soirée, il teste leurs connaissances et leur culture générale. La soirée vire au cauchemar lorsque Mo perd le contrôle...

programme.title: L'heure sombre
programme.desc: Rares survivants d'une guerre bactériologique, une petite communauté dirigée par Maria vit enfermée dans un immeuble en plein délabrement. Dehors, l'ensemble de la population a été transformée en zombies : le moindre contact et c'est la mort assurée. Et puis il y a les êtres invisibles, des entités qui se baladent librement dans l'immeuble. Le seul moyen de détecter leur présence est une subite baisse de la température, connue sous le nom de l'heure froide...

programme.title: Ma meilleure amie
programme.desc: Un homme prend conscience de ses véritables sentiments lorsque sa meilleure amie lui annonce qu'elle va se marier. Va-t-il lui avouer son amour ?

programme.title: Le crime parfait
programme.desc: Un détective traque la meurtrière potentielle de sa fille, suspectée dans une affaire récente, pour obtenir justice et apaiser sa soif de vengeance.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: Allemagne, 2029. Le pays est dirigé depuis peu par un gouvernement populiste d'extrême droite. Alors qu'une nouvelle échéance électorale approche, la situation politique se tend. Le journaliste Johann Hellström, depuis longtemps dans le viseur d'un pouvoir de plus en plus autoritaire, se voit interdit d'exercer après avoir diffusé une fausse information obtenue d'une source qu'il croyait fiable. Pour lui, cela ne fait aucun doute : il a été victime d'une machination. Il se réfugie alors avec son épouse Lucia dans leur maison de vacances, endroit parfait pour échapper aux menaces, d'autant qu'elle est équipée de technologies de domotique. Mais la "maison connectée", régie par une intelligence artificielle, commence bientôt à montrer d'étranges défaillances. D'évidence, on cherche à nouveau à faire tomber Johann.

programme.title: Emprise
programme.desc: Mo et son amie Vera sont surprises en train de tricher à leur examen par Ursu, leur professeur d'université. Lorsque Mo demande une seconde chance, le professeur les invite chez lui. Tout au long de la soirée, il teste leurs connaissances et leur culture générale. La soirée vire au cauchemar lorsque Mo perd le contrôle...

programme.title: Âme soeur
programme.desc: La veille de son mariage et contre toute attente, une jeune femme pense rencontrer l'amour de sa vie. Ils décident de passer toute la nuit ensemble.

programme.title: Snooker: Northern Ireland Open
programme.desc: Die Statistik sprach im vorjährigen Finale für Judd Trump. Er besiegte Jack Lisowski bei allen acht vorigen Duellen, darunter waren die Endspiele beim World Grand Prix (2020), bei den German Masters (2021) und den Gibraltar Open (2021). Diesmal aber drehte Lisowski den Spieß um.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de esquí alpino M - Sölden
programme.desc: Como suele ser tradicional, la cita de Sölden inaugura la Copa del mundo de esquí alpino. Se disputa en el glaciar Rettenbach (Austria) con un exigente eslalon gigante masculino que reúne a la élite mundial del esquí. El pentacampeón Marco Odermatt es el rival a batir.

programme.title: Copa del mundo de esquí alpino M - Kitzbuehel
programme.desc: Del 26 de octubre al 25 de marzo se celebra la Copa del mundo de esquí alpino. La competición, que premia a los más regulares, hace su 13ª parada en Kitzbuehel, Austria. El helvético Marco Odermatt defiende título.

programme.title: Abierto de Irlanda del Norte de snooker
programme.desc: El Abierto de Irlanda del Norte de snooker se disputa del 18 al 25 de octubre en el Waterfront Hall de Belfast. Es un torneo clave de las Home Nations Series donde la élite busca el trofeo Alex Higgins. El inglés Jack Lisowski se impuso en 2025.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A nightmare starts when Chris starts renovating his family dream house - with a haunting ghost. Only with the help of paranormal investigators, priests, psychics and shamans does Chris figure out a way to protect his family.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Hanggai brings Inner Mongolian grasslands to New York
programme.desc: You don't need to speak the language to be captivated by Hanggai's music. This Chinese folk-rock band blends powerful vocals, traditional instruments and rock energy into a sound all its own. programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan's four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China's most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang's First Peak - this time, he's all in.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes

In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The secluded region of Abruzzo makes for unique Italian cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us diverse regional recipes like Rolled Meat Crepes.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Pasta, bread, pizza dough! Host Michael Bonacini makes Apulian classics like Artichoke Cheese Panzerotti.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies..

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business.

programme.title: Leather Burners
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) gets the call when a herd of rustled cattle mysteriously disappear. Andy Clyde, Victor Jory and George Reeves (televisions Superman!) also star in this, the 42nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy features. If you look closely, you might even notice Robert Mitchum in an uncredited role.

programme.title: Down Texas Way
programme.desc: The sixth film in Monogram's Rough Rider series once again follows Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), Tom McCoy (Tim McCall), and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) as undercover US Marshals posing as outlaws in order to confound their enemies. When Sandy is framed for murder by a gang of frontier racketeers who hope to take over a small town as their headquarters, Buck and Tom must work separately to save their buddy from a lynch mob and foil the crook's dastardly schemes.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: The Main Guard of Valletta
programme.desc: This feature explores the story of the Main Guard building in St George’s Square, Valletta, through the research and investigations carried out ahead of its restoration. It reveals discoveries about the building’s history and the various plans proposed for it over the years, including a period when its very survival was uncertain. The feature shows how research undertaken before restoration can uncover important chapters in the history of a landmark building.

programme.title: Djinn & Water
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: Whatever Became Of Baby Custer
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: Where'd You Go-Go
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: Russian Roulette
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: What House Across The Street
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.sub-title: S5:E138 One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: The Chili King
programme.desc: Tony's unauthorized chili is "hot" not because of the sauce, but because of his conniving cousin Arvel.

programme.title: The Lady In The Bottle
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: My Hero
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Marriage Caper
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: G.I. Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: The Yacht Murder Case
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Anybody Here Seen Jeannie
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: The Americanization Of Jeannie
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: The Moving Finger
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: Djinn & Water
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: Whatever Became Of Baby Custer
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: Where'd You Go-Go
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: Russian Roulette
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: What House Across The Street
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.sub-title: S5:E138 One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: The Chili King

programme.title: The Lady In The Bottle
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
